content.title: Barcelona Overcomes Rayo Vallecano and Strengthens Its Lead in La Liga
content.text: Discover moreLive Video StreamingSport Scores & StatisticsSports Barcelona Overcomes Rayo Vallecano and Strengthens Its Lead in La Liga Sunday 22-03-2026 2 0 Share As part of the 29th round of the Spanish League, FC Barcelona hosted Rayo Vallecano at Spotify Camp Nou and managed to secure a 1-0 victory, further strengthening their position at the top of the standings.The Uruguayan defender Ronald Araújo scored the only goal of the match with a brilliant header following a perfectly executed corner by João Cancelo, granting the Catalan team three valuable points in their battle for the La Liga title.Rayo Vallecano failed to threaten Barcelona's goal throughout the match, leaving empty-handed despite their limited attempts.With this victory, Barcelona increased its tally to 73 points at the top of the Spanish league standings, while Rayo Vallecano remained at 32 points in the fourteenth position.
